name: fxr_savept084
doc: Stands in for saves/field_re/savept084_lake.state, its own provenance on the playthrough: the sanctum's upper hall (loc 084, the playthrough's leg 25 end: Crono, Lucca, Frog, storyline 15) reloaded by the ROM's own loader on the save point's tile (3,39) facing up (--teleport 0x84 3 39 0, method jmp, 120 frames), with the capture's first bag slot poked in ($2400 = C8, $2500 = 02: two Shelters, which the playthrough's party never bought -- the shelter check uses one).
